theorem.flatness: a section c is linear iff delta=(c2-c0-c1,c3-2c0-c1)=(0,0)
theorem.orbits: Aut(H_3) has exactly two orbits on inverse-closed sections: 9 flat and 72 curved
theorem.smith_jump: curvature changes both the rational spectrum and the integral critical group; there are no cospectral/non-Smith-equivalent sections at q=3
theorem.spectral_jump: flat spectrum 8^1,2^12,(-1)^8,(-4)^6; curved spectrum 8^1,(-1)^14, roots of x^2-x-11 each with multiplicity 6
